## Issues Found and Fix

- WebsiteSource's copy script incorrectly required a separate `app.worker.js` for every Emscripten version. It now requires that nonempty file only when referenced by `app.mjs`, accepts module workers and removes a stale separate worker. All 22 isolated copy cases passed, including missing/empty required inputs, a missing final worker/page, spaces in paths and unchanged destinations after failure. The reusable job/project/publication instructions now document both layouts.
- The initial Chromium and Firefox touch regressions expected a short press to retain a selection. The current SOP requires ordinary caret collapse. Updated the test to check collapse, End-time long-press behavior and range restoration before scrolling. The corrected three-pass Firefox FCT lifecycle exceeded the generic 120-second limit; its scoped allowance is now 180 seconds.
- Detailed SOP testing reproduced two real read-only mutations: Selectable allowed hyperlink edits/removal and ribbon style application. The authored base now checks editability for hyperlink commands; the ribbon gallery observes EditModeChanged and its apply handler also guards Editable mode. Updated Windows UIA assertions, the SOP and the real-Wasm browser regression. The regression failed on the old binary and passed after regeneration. Source fix: `716b5eb35`; generated snapshots: `e5aef3b16`; browser regression: GacJS `9f8a5f8`.
